name: Synovia
tagline: Predicts the neurological effects of removing a given brain region before surgery.

awards: Best Healthcare Hack [Courtesy of Daylight Health]

problem: Brain-tumor surgeries have unexpected complications because tissue behaviour is hard to predict, the team says.
solution: Given region, coordinates, volume and age, an AI predicts deficits, recovery and risk, with a 3D brain simulation for what-if scenarios.
demo_moment: Team-described: select a region and see predicted deficits on a 3D brain.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Healthcare Hack [Courtesy of Daylight Health]” among 195 submissions.
High-stakes medical framing with a simple input form.
Clinical predictions from a weekend model need validation the summary does not show.

lessons: Medical what-if tools must state what they cannot predict.
